entities.summary: Count Aladár Zichy de Zich et Vásonkeő was a Hungarian politician, who served as Minister besides the King twice: between 1906 and 1910 and during the end of the First World War. He was also Minister of Croatian Affairs in the third Wekerle cabinet.
